title: Settling-Period Rates for Reinspections under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
**Clause.** The visit charge of a re-measurement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a settling-period multiplier, applied to the program's reinspection fee. The settling-period multiplier follows the whole calendar months from the coverage start date to the assessment day: fewer than 12 months take 0.75; 12 to 23 months take 0.90; 24 months or more take 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Whole calendar months from the coverage start date to the assessment day | Settling-period multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 to 11 | 0.75 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.90 |
| 24 or more | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical coverage start date 10 May 2024)

| Assessment day | Whole calendar months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 9 May 2025 | 11 | 0.75 |
| 10 May 2025 | 12 | 0.90 |
| 9 May 2026 | 23 | 0.90 |
| 10 May 2026 | 24 | 1.00 |

The coverage start date is the original closing date of the home, the same for every owner, so a subsequent owner's coverage reads the same months as the original buyer's would.
